definition: A hard rock with large crystals set in a finer-grained base.
book: Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
quote: We were two hours getting to the summit of this peak, which was half porphyry and half basalt.
example_sentence: The palace steps were cut from purple porphyry.
